name: Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy for Inline Entity Form
description: Integrates Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy with Inline Entity Form, allowing the IEF widgets to be used on Entity Reference Hierarchy fields.
project_description: Submodule of Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy that integrates the hierarchy field types with the Inline Entity Form module. It provides an inline_entity_form_hierarchy field widget extending InlineEntityFormComplex, adding a depth textfield to each inline entity row and a Depth column with drag-and-drop tabledrag re-parenting to the IEF entity table. The widget targets both the entity_reference_hierarchy and entity_reference_hierarchy_revisions field types, and merges the per-row depth back into the field values in massageFormValues(), so referenced entities can be created and edited inline while building the tree. Depends on inline_entity_form.
